title: Stegosaurus grunt (sound design from real animal recordings)
author: DigiZoo sound design from recordings by Kent Wang; National Park Service
changes: Movie-style dinosaur call: no recordings of dinosaurs exist, so it was designed from real animal recordings (hippopotamus honks and an American alligator groan, pitched down and layered). Sound design from 2 real recordings: "Hippopotamuses vocalising in South Africa" 1.55–3.00 s, slowed to 0.7× speed (pitched down 30%); "Alligator (NPS Sound Gallery)" 7.30–9.00 s, slowed to 0.8× speed (pitched down 20%), placed at 0.20 s; then mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 28 Hz, added reverb, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
